hero.filename: St. John's Lutheran Church on Avery Street.jpg
hero.caption: Front and southern side of the former St. John's Lutheran Church, located on the southern side of Avery Street between 9th and 9½th Streets in Parkersburg, West Virginia, United States.  Built in 1907, it is part of the Avery Street Historic District, a historic district that is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
